description: Source code for an SSE server transport class (SseServerTransport) handling server-sent events and POST messages for MCP, using FastAPI, starlette, and anyio.

classes.name: SseServerTransport
classes.description: Handles server-sent events (SSE) and POST message processing for MCP, providing ASGI applications for connection and message handling.

methods.name: connect_sse
methods.description: Asynchronous context manager establishing an SSE connection, yielding read and write streams.

methods.name: handle_post_message
methods.description: Processes incoming POST requests to send messages to a specific SSE session identified by session_id.
